v1.0.0 — Initial Release

☀️ FEATURES
- Morning briefing with overdue, priorities, calendar, context
- Focus statement — ONE thing to concentrate on
- Weekly preview mode
- End-of-day variant (adapts to time)
- Integrates with ai-meeting-notes to-do list
- Customizable preferences

Built by Jeff J Hunter

raw_record.summary: Start every day focused. Get a morning briefing with overdue tasks, today's priorities, calendar overview, and context from recent meetings. Works with ai-meeting-notes to-do list. No setup. Just say 'briefing'.
